scope: Finite native empty-volume and empty-snapshot initialization EC2 observations, not complete EBS/EC2 parity; real snapshot bytes and source KMS authority belong to volume_data fixtures.

fixtures.volume_controls.json: Create/read/attribute/status/modify/delete lifecycle, native IAM conditions, tags, client token equivalence and page-token replay.
fixtures.volume_controls_configuration.json: DryRun-only cross-field normalization precedence and unmasked io1/io2 IOPS ceilings; no resources allocated.
fixtures.volume_controls_io.json: Two 4-GiB/100-IOPS Multi-Attach sources: io1 immutable controls and successful io2 atomic Multi-Attach disable/type conversion.
fixtures.volume_controls_deletion.json: Immediate deletion after creating response and exact EnableVolumeIO missing/malformed ID precedence.
fixtures.volume_controls_events.json: Delivered native optimizing and completed modifyVolume notifications through one owned EventBridge rule/SQS queue; all resources cleaned.
fixtures.volume_controls_initialization.json: One empty 1-GiB direct snapshot: ordinary and100/300-MiB/s provisioned-rate volumes, invalid0/99/301 actual/DryRun admission, initialization status transition and projection.
fixtures.volume_controls_snapshot_ids.json: 37 controlled snapshot identifiers across DescribeSnapshots, DescribeSnapshotAttribute and CreateVolume DryRun only; no resources allocated.
fixtures.volume_controls_snapshot_id_bits.json: 198 read-only calls sweeping selected nibbles of two proven-issued IDs and comparing a western source across regional endpoints; compact derivation in volume_controls_snapshot_ids_contract.json.
fixtures.volume_controls_bounds.json: Numeric lower boundaries, fresh growth, modified/deleted token behavior, EnableVolumeIO, pagination bounds, completed modification repetition.

contracts.create_zone: Absent or empty zone/name ID: MissingParameter zone. Missing size and snapshot with valid zone: MissingParameter size/snapshot. Unknown zone: InvalidZone.NotFound. Both selectors: InvalidParameterCombination. Name and corresponding ZoneId select the same zone and are client-token equivalent.
contracts.create_defaults: VolumeType omitted or empty becomes gp2; uppercase GP3 normalizes to gp3. 1-GiB gp2 Iops=100; gp3 Iops=3000/Throughput=125; standard omits Iops/Throughput. io1/io2 accepted at 4 GiB/100 IOPS. CreateVolume returns creating, SnapshotId empty string, Tags empty array if untagged, MultiAttachEnabled=false, Encrypted=false under the observed unchanged default. It omits Attachments, OwnerId, VolumeArn, Operator and FastRestored.
contracts.describe_fields: DescribeVolumes adds Attachments=[], OwnerId, VolumeArn and Operator {Managed:false,HiddenByDefault:false}. Empty source SnapshotId persists. CreateTime includes milliseconds unlike CreateVolume whole-second output. No unmeasured encryption/Outpost initialization field presence is inferred.
contracts.create_validation: Actual and DryRun validate missing zone/size, size bounds, type, IOPS/throughput combinations and tags before IAM/DryRun. gp3 MultiAttachEnabled=true is rejected only on actual request; DryRun succeeds. ClientToken length65 is rejected only on actual request; DryRun succeeds.
contracts.iops_and_throughput: gp3 Iops=2999 and3001 at1GiB fail maximum500 IOPS/GiB ratio; baseline3000 is exempt. Throughput124 is accepted and normalized125. Throughput2001 rejects maximum2000,751 with3000IOPS rejects ratio0.25. gp2/standard reject explicit positive Iops or Throughput. io1/io2 require Iops; minimum100; io1 at4GiB201IOPS rejects maximum50 IOPS/GiB. st1/sc1 at1GiB reject minimum125GiB; no valid HDD allocations made.
contracts.upper_bounds: DryRun native errors establish gp2 maximum16384GiB, gp3 maximum65536GiB, standard maximum1024GiB, gp3 maximum80000IOPS. Supplemental 4GiB io1/io2 requests establish maximum64000/256000IOPS; io2 at4GiB4001IOPS rejects maximum1000IOPS/GiB.
contracts.tag_validation: Wrong ResourceType snapshot, duplicate key, aws:-reserved key and empty tag key return InvalidParameterValue, including DryRun. Returned tag order can differ from request order.
contracts.create_tokens: Exact replay returns same ID and live lifecycle state. Reordered tag entries and AZ-name to equivalent AZ-ID replay succeed. Changed size/tags reject IdempotentParameterMismatch. Replaying deleted resource with original parameters returns IdempotentParameterMismatch with dedicated already-deleted message; changed parameters use generic mismatch first.
contracts.attributes: Default AutoEnableIO false. ProductCodes empty array. No/empty Attribute => InvalidParameterCombination No attributes specified. Unknown Attribute => InvalidParameterValue Unknown attribute. ModifyVolumeAttribute without AutoEnableIO or empty {} => No attributes specified; true/false persists and SDK success output is {}. Attribute DryRun precedes missing/bad IDs and malformed attributes.
contracts.status_available: Available volume status is ok with io-enabled=passed and io-performance=not-applicable; Actions/Events empty arrays; AZ name/id, Operator managed=false/hidden=false present. VolumeIds containing only empty string is treated as all in DescribeVolumeStatus, unlike the other Describe APIs.
contracts.delete_lifecycle: DeleteVolume SDK output {}. Immediate DescribeVolumes can still return deleting. DescribeVolumeStatus and DescribeVolumesModifications may already return InvalidVolume.NotFound; subsequent DeleteVolume/DescribeVolumes become NotFound. Exact observed times are not removal guarantees.
contracts.delete_admission: Missing VolumeId gives MissingParameter before DryRun. Empty/bad ID gives InvalidParameterValue malformed before DryRun and even before explicit-deny IAM. Other describe/mutate operations have different native ID/error precedence.
contracts.zero_id_boundary: vol-00000000000000000 is natively malformed, not a well-formed absent volume. True NotFound evidence uses previously-created then deleted owned IDs in supplemental fixture.
contracts.modify_admission: ModifyVolume with no fields: InvalidParameterValue Must specify at least one of size, type, iops, throughput or multi-attach. Same size is accepted as a real modification. Shrink: InvalidParameterValue New size cannot be smaller than existing size. ModifyVolume DryRun bypasses these validation failures. Active modifications can reject IncorrectModificationState with uppercase MODIFYING in message.
contracts.modify_lifecycle: A 1GiB gp3 size growth and a1GiB gp2->gp3 conversion each reported modifying/Progress0 then completed/Progress100, with native StartTime-to-EndTime2seconds. gp2 conversion defaults to target3000IOPS/125throughput. OriginalThroughput absent for gp2. DescribeVolumesModifications adds Operator, unlike ModifyVolume. Repeated completed modifications succeeded within seconds; do not impose blanket6hour cooldown.
contracts.modification_absence: Describing existing never-modified volume gives InvalidVolumeModification.NotFound: Modification for volume <id> does not exist. This preceded invalid filter in observed request.
contracts.filters: DescribeVolumes supports tested documented selectors plus undocumented tag-value. Empty values=>empty match set; unknown filter InvalidParameterValue. Modification volume-id,modification-state,original-size,target-size,target-volume-type work; documented targetMultiAttachEnabled is invalid in native.
contracts.id_pagination_combination: All three listing APIs reject VolumeIds combined with MaxResults or NextToken, before bound checks. Error uses volumeIdsSet for Volumes/Status and volumeModificationSet for Modifications.
contracts.volume_pagination: DescribeVolumes MaxResults1 rejects,5 succeeds with a real continuation token. Token replay returns same next-page records. Changing filter while reusing token succeeds with empty results rather than a filter-binding token error.
contracts.creation_iam: CreateVolume requires account-filled volume ARN, unlike snapshot empty-account ARN. Request-tag and ec2:VolumeType/AvailabilityZone/VolumeSize conditions work; ec2:ResourceTag/suite was absent during creation. Tagged requests require dependent CreateTags including on DryRun; untagged requests do not. ec2:CreateAction=CreateVolume allows tagging. Invalid zone/size validation precedes explicit-deny IAM.
contracts.gp3_low_bound_normalization: Native gp3 Iops0/1 rejects minimum100. Iops500 at1GiB accepts but normalizes3000;501 fails500IOPS/GiB ratio. Negative Iops/Throughput reject positive-integer validation. Throughput0/1/124 accepts normalized125. DryRun Iops100 withThroughput750 succeeds; Iops500 withThroughput751 rejects ratio0.250333. Validate requested IOPS/GiB before baseline normalization, then validate throughput against normalized IOPS.
contracts.token_original_request_and_live_output: Each explicit default Iops3000,Encryptedfalse,MultiAttachEnabledfalse mismatches omission; Throughput125 matches omission. After growth from1to2GiB the original size1 request replay returns currentSize2; a request withsize2 rejects generic mismatch against the original request. Original request after deletion gives dedicated deleted-resource mismatch.
contracts.status_creating: DescribeVolumeStatus immediately after CreateVolume gave statusok/details passed+not-applicable while the following DescribeVolumes still showed creating; do not derive healthstatus from lifecyclecreating.
contracts.enable_volume_io: EnableVolumeIO on available healthy volume returns IncorrectState: Volume <id> already has IO enabled. DryRunOperation bypasses this. Deleted owned ID actual is InvalidVolume.NotFound, DryRunOperation withDryRun.
contracts.modification_quota: A fresh volume accepted four modifications including same-size noops after each reachedcompleted. Fifth returned VolumeModificationRateExceeded with next eligible time exactly first accepted modification+24h to milliseconds. Native message: You've reached the maximum modification rate per volume limit. Wait until <UTC time> before you can issue the next modification request for this volume.
contracts.all_pagination_bounds: Across Volumes,Status,Modifications, MaxResults-1,0,1,4 rejects minimum5;5,500,501,1000,1001 all accepted. No upper bound is established. Modifications error spells MaxResults, others maxResults. Malformed tokens: Volumes/Status Unable to parse pagination token; Modifications Value ( invalid ) for parameter NextToken is invalid. The token is Invalid.
contracts.modification_multiattach_filters: Native accepts original-multi-attach-enabled and target-multi-attach-enabled. Both documented originalMultiAttachEnabled and targetMultiAttachEnabled are invalid.
contracts.multiattach_modification: io1 Multi-Attach enabled volumes reject same-size, type change and disabling Multi-Attach with InvalidParameterValue: io1 volumes with Multi-Attach enabled do not support modify-volume actions. Please review the EBS technical documentation for information on the Multi-Attach limitations and considerations. io2 Multi-Attach enabled volume accepts same-size modification and then atomic VolumeType=gp3/MultiAttachEnabled=false, completing with original io2/100IOPS and target gp3/3000IOPS/125throughput.
contracts.immediate_delete: DeleteVolume immediately after CreateVolume's creating response succeeds; following DescribeVolumes shows deleting.
contracts.enable_id_admission: EnableVolumeIO absent/empty IDs return MissingParameter with volumeId null/empty message; bad returns InvalidParameterValue Expected vol-.... The syntactically shaped all-zero ID returns InternalError HTTP500 An internal error has occurred. All tested EnableVolumeIO DryRun cases return DryRunOperation.
contracts.modify_volume_notifications: Owned EventBridge-to-SQS delivered optimizing then completed EBS Volume Notification events for one 1-to-2GiB gp3 modification. Both details contain only event=modifyVolume, result=optimizing/completed, cause empty string, request-id equal to ModifyVolume HTTP request ID. Source aws.ec2; resources use account-filled regional volume ARN. No modifying event was received during90seconds; missing delivery is not proof of absence.
contracts.initialization_rate_admission: With an owned completed empty 1-GiB direct snapshot, rates0/99/301 fail actual and DryRun with InvalidParameterValue: The value specified for VolumeInitializationRate is not in the allowed range. Rates100/300 succeed actual and return DryRunOperation withDryRun. Omitted rate succeeds. CreateVolume and DescribeVolumes publish VolumeInitializationRate only when specified.
contracts.initialization_status: Both ordinary and provisioned-rate restored volumes initially report healthy I/O plus VolumeStatus.Details initialization-state=initializing and InitializationStatusDetails Progress0. InitializationType is default when rate omitted, provisioned-rate when100/300 specified; only provisioned-rate includes EstimatedTimeToCompleteInSeconds=0. All three later report initialization-state=completed and Progress100; provisioned-rate ETA0 remains. Source FullSnapshotSizeInBytes=0: this is metadata publication evidence, not a data-bearing hydration bandwidth/duration measurement.
contracts.snapshot_identifier_evidence: All three sampled APIs agree on each controlled ID classification. Lowercase length17 and leading0 are insufficient to establish native acceptance. The reported0123456789abcdef0 is malformed, while0fedcba9876543210 and0ffffffffffffffff reachNotFound. Single-nibble acceptance varies with the remaining identifier; measured east/west endpoint classifications agree. No universal native checksum/type/version decoder has been established or implemented.
contracts.status_page_filter_order: Status with nonmatching AZ filter andMaxResults5 returned emptyVolumeStatuses plusNextToken. Do not infer that an empty page is terminal.

boundaries: Native timing is observational, not a service latency guarantee. Initialization mode adds one owned empty direct snapshot; no attachment/instance execution, customer data, KMS key creation or standing-setting changes occur in this control probe.

No optimizing state was observed in the initial DescribeVolumesModifications polls; later native EventBridge capture positively recorded optimizing and completed. Local +1s/+2s scheduling and optimizing progress50 are explicit emulator policy, not native latency/progress guarantees.
SDK-decoded field presence and omissions are captured; raw XML element presence is not separately asserted.

Snapshot identifier supplements are investigative evidence, not a validator parity claim. Finite nibble and region samples do not justify fixture-ID blacklists, independent nibble whitelists, or an invented decoder.
Credentials, authorization failure blobs and pagination bearer tokens are not persisted; pagination token equality uses SHA-256 fingerprints.
